resources.string: PowerPoint or PDF · we explain every slide
Add a presentation. PowerPoint or PDF, we explain every slide
Your photos will be removed from this video. A video is made from photos or from a presentation, not both.
This usually takes up to half a minute. You can wait here.
We\'ll explain every slide in the narration.
Slides are wide. In a vertical video they look small, with empty space above and below. Landscape 16:9 shows them best.
Use landscape 16:9, the best shape for slides
Optional: who is it for? For example: for executives, or for students.
Add a few more words, or leave the description empty
Presentations can be up to %1$d MB. Try making the pictures smaller, or export it as a PDF.
We can narrate up to %1$d slides. Split it into two files, or choose a shorter one.
Save a copy without a password and choose it again. Old .ppt files also need saving as .pptx or PDF.
For your safety we can\'t open files with macros or embedded programs. Save it as .pptx without macros, or export it as a PDF.
It may be damaged. Open it on your computer, export it as a PDF, and choose that one.
We can\'t use that kind of file
Choose a PowerPoint (.pptx) or a PDF. From Keynote, Google Slides or an older PowerPoint, use Export as .pptx or PDF.
We didn\'t find any slides in it. Choose a file with at least one slide.
It didn\'t pass our safety check. Choose a different presentation.
This presentation was too heavy to prepare. Choose it again, or export it as a PDF to make it lighter.
Something in it didn\'t convert. Export it as a PDF and choose that one, or try the same file again.
Your presentation didn\'t finish uploading. Check your connection and try again.
Nothing was lost. Try again in a moment.
You can add up to 10 a day. Try again tomorrow.
Please try again later. Your photos and ideas still work.
This is taking longer than usual
Your presentation is still being prepared. You can keep waiting, or choose another file.
We couldn\'t prepare your presentation. Choose the file again.
